name: thin-main-runnable-core
description: gofib CLI testability: keep main() as a thin flag.Parse + error-exit shim and put all output logic in run(w io.Writer, count int) error, so tests exercise CLI behavior (counts, formats, invalid -n values) via bytes.Buffer instead of os/exec subprocesses. New flags should validate in run and surface errors through main's stderr+exit-1 path.

A previous implementer pass left a compiled 'gofib' binary in the worktree root (gitignored, so the gate stayed green). Hard rule: build smoke checks must not leave binaries behind — use 'go run .' (builds to cache) or build into a temp dir outside the worktree, and remove any stray binary before finishing the pass.
resolution: Binary removed with 'rm -f gofib'; smoke checks now use 'go run .' which builds into the Go cache and never touches the worktree.

title: -start 0 normalizes to 1 inside run()
rationale: gofib indices are 1-based and pinned by README ('100: 354224848179261915075') and existing tests, so a -start flag defaulting to 0 must reproduce today's output exactly; the seed's 'Default 0' was resolved to '0 behaves like unset'

content: Optional range flags in gofib (-start, -limit) use 0 as the 'no-op sentinel' default so unset output stays historically identical; validate with the exact error format 'invalid value <v> for flag -<name>: must be >= 0', checked in run() AFTER the -version early-return so -version always wins even with invalid values; compose by shrinking the effective last index before any output or pretty-width computation. New range flags should mirror all three parts.

name: new-flag-without-helper-ripple
description: When adding a new flag to gofib's options struct, avoid rippling the positional opts() test helper through ~40 call sites: add a small clone helper (stepOpts) that sets the new field, and only touch existing tests where defaults change (TestParseOptionsDefaults literal). run() must defensively clamp new stride-like fields to safe values because validation is skipped under -seed/-version.
